Part 1 高频 物品 OBJECTS

Food

食物

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

问题与答案

Q1What is your favourite food?

My current favourite is a seafood dish called huajia, which are clams, usually stir-fried with garlic and chilli. I love how fresh and juicy they are, and the sauce is really addictive. Honestly, I could eat them every week.

最爱吃花甲，蒜蓉辣椒炒的，鲜嫩多汁很上瘾。

Q2What kind of food did you like when you were young?

When I was young, I was crazy about latiao, those spicy snack sticks sold at every corner shop. I used to save my pocket money to buy them after school, even though my parents warned me they weren't healthy.

小时候超爱辣条，攒零花钱放学买来吃。

Q3Do you eat different foods at different times of the year?

Yeah, to some extent. In summer we eat lighter dishes, while in winter we go for heavier, warming meals like hotpot. But the staples at home are basically always chicken, duck, goose and pork, no matter the season.

季节不同吃法不同，夏天清淡冬天暖和，但家里常备鸡鸭鹅猪肉。

Q4Has your favourite food changed since you were a child?

Definitely, it has changed. As a kid, I only cared about snacks like latiao, but now my taste is completely different. These days I'm much more into proper dishes like clams, so my favourite has shifted to something healthier.

口味变了，从小爱吃辣条到现在爱吃花甲这类正经菜。
